reason: The end-to-end gate is deliberately separate from Node and unit coverage. Its denominator is the executable inventory emitted by the Chromium and packaged Electron builds, and every required runtime surface must contribute evidence. All four Istanbul metrics are fixed at literal 100 percent; this file is a contract, not a ratchet.
